messages:
Nina Rao: Heads up 1! We have an onsite for candidate Riley Chen next Thu (June 3). Window 10:00am 2:30pm PT. Riley asked for a quiet room between interviews due to sensory sensitivity and also needs gluten-free lunch. Can Facilities confirm quiet room and access?

Samir Patel: I can cover panel 10:30 11:15 (design). Im ok with the schedule.

Facilities: Noted. We can reserve 'Quiet Suite B' on 3rd floor. Need a short note on required accommodations for front desk. Also: reserved an extra office chair and soft lighting.

Nina Rao: Thanks. Add note: "sensory-friendly space, minimal fluorescent lights, no perfume." Facilities, can we pre-load a room sign that says "Private interview in progress"?

Facilities: Yes. We'll place a temporary door sign and lower overhead lighting. We'll also reserve a nearby lactation/quiet room in case of breaks.

People Ops Bot: Badge request created  BR-9021. Expected ready 24h before visit.

Nina Rao: Lunch: vendor is 'GreenFork' (gluten-free + vegan options). Samir, can you confirm dietary notes on the calendar invite?

Samir Patel: Yep will update invite and add the lunch order preference.

Nina Rao: IT: Riley needs a HDMI adapter for their laptop and a printed copy of the coding prompt. If possible, set up a small whiteboard in Quiet Suite B.

IT Helpdesk: HDMI adapter and whiteboard booked. Will bring adapter kit and marker set. Ticket IT-6687.

Nina Rao: Also Riley asked about reimbursement for ferry + BART. Policy is local travel up to $150. I'll attach expense code EXP-HIRE-LOCAL. Candidate prefers Venmo reimbursement. Is that allowed?

People Ops Bot: Payment policy: Venmo is not allowed. Reimbursements via ACH only. Please share bank details after offer.

Nina Rao: Noted. I'll tell Riley ACH only. Last thing: can Facilities confirm nearest accessible entrance and meet-and-greet desk person? We prefer to have a staff greeter at check-in.

Facilities: Meet-and-greet assigned: Jordan M. Will meet candidate at accessible entrance (South Lobby) at 9:55am, will escort to Quiet Suite B and panel rooms.

Nina Rao: Perfect. Action items: (1) Facilities: door sign + greeter + Quiet Suite B (2) IT: adapter + whiteboard (3) People Ops: badge + expense code + ACH note (4) Samir: update invite with dietary and panel notes. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Samir Patel: :white_check_mark:

Facilities: :white_check_mark:

IT Helpdesk: :white_check_mark:
